selected_aggregation: training-aligned mean of all one-second probability vectors

deployment_decision_stage.selection_target: MLP versus CNN as the application default
deployment_decision_stage.reason: User prioritizes reviewed external recordings and baby cry; MLP improves these scores and uses fewer parameters, while sacrificing some classes and ESC macro recall.

external_role: Previously seen development-validation cohort, also used for the present default-backend decision; not a new blind test.
training_protocol_note: model_selection=false in the frozen training protocol describes fitting before external audio was opened; it does not claim the later deployment choice was independent of external scores.
